mechanism.moa: GLP-1 receptor agonist — stimulates insulin secretion and suppresses glucagon in a glucose-dependent manner; slows gastric emptying.
mechanism.plausibility_rationale: GLP-1 receptor agonism directly stimulates pancreatic exocrine secretion and has been shown in preclinical models to increase pancreatic ductal pressure. Several mechanistic reviews support a biological link.
